This phase 1 dose-escalation study reports outcomes in two initial dose cohorts, but the abstract does not indicate randomized allocation. The dose-group comparison therefore is not a randomized between-group comparison.

This is a prospective observational cohort study comparing vaccinated with unvaccinated participants under real-world conditions, with propensity adjustment. Vaccination was not randomly allocated, so it does not report a randomized-group comparison.
Genetic and mechanistic case-series study of 12 patients from five families; no randomized intervention or comparison between randomized groups is reported.

Prospective observational postmortem study comparing deaths among persons with versus without known HIV infection; participants were not randomly allocated, so no randomized-group comparison is reported.

This is explicitly an international observational cohort study comparing treatments selected in clinical practice using inverse-probability weighting; participants were not randomly allocated to treatment groups.

Reports primary outcome results from a prospective cluster-randomized trial, directly comparing dengue and hospitalization outcomes between intervention clusters receiving Wolbachia-infected mosquito deployments and control clusters receiving no deployments.

Reports primary outcome results from an open-label multicenter trial that randomly assigned 196 women 1:1 to FETO or expectant care and directly compared survival and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized trial reporting direct olaparib-versus-placebo comparisons for invasive and distant disease-free survival, mortality, safety, and quality of life.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 3 double-blind randomized trial, directly comparing nivolumab with placebo after radical surgery.
Participants were randomly assigned 1:1 to BNT162b2 or placebo, and the report directly compares randomized groups on safety and confirmed Covid-19 efficacy outcomes.
Final/follow-up results from a randomized trial of intensive versus standard blood-pressure targets, with direct between-group comparisons of cardiovascular outcomes, mortality, and adverse events.
Reports primary efficacy and safety outcomes from a prospective randomized comparison of endovascular therapy versus standard medical care in 300 patients.

Reports primary results of a multicenter randomized controlled trial in 349 patients, with direct comparisons of rehabilitation versus usual care for physical function, rehospitalization, and mortality outcomes.
Children were randomly assigned to tympanostomy-tube placement or medical management, and the report directly compares primary and secondary outcomes between the randomized groups.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from an open-label phase 3 randomized controlled trial, with direct comparisons of both randomized 4-month rifapentine regimens against the randomized standard 6-month control regimen.

Reports primary results of a multicenter, double-blind randomized controlled trial comparing tranexamic acid with placebo, with direct between-group analyses of postpartum hemorrhage and other outcomes.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, with direct comparisons between the Ad26.COV2.S vaccine and placebo groups.

Reports primary 6-week results from a double-blind randomized controlled trial in humans, with direct between-group comparisons of psilocybin versus escitalopram for depression outcomes and adverse events.
Phase 3 human trial with explicit random assignment to two upadacitinib doses, placebo, or adalimumab; it reports and directly compares randomized-group efficacy and safety outcomes.
Reports results from a double-blind randomized controlled trial comparing ChAdOx1 nCoV-19 vaccine with placebo, including COVID-19 efficacy and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Phase 2 human trial with patients randomly assigned 1:1 to donanemab or placebo; the publication reports and directly compares clinical, imaging, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Phase 3 human trial with patients randomly assigned to terlipressin or placebo; the publication reports and directly compares primary, secondary, mortality, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Reports outcomes from an adaptive randomized trial in which critically ill patients with Covid-19 were assigned to tocilizumab, sarilumab, or standard care, with direct comparisons of organ support-free days and survival between randomized groups.

Reports primary results from an open-label, two-cohort dose-selection study, but no random allocation is described; the unequal low- and high-dose cohorts do not establish a randomized-group comparison.

Phase 3 human trial with 608 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to enfortumab vedotin or investigator-chosen chemotherapy; it directly compares overall survival, progression-free survival, and adverse events between the randomized groups.

Double-blind human trial with random assignment to semaglutide or placebo; it reports and directly compares weight-loss, cardiometabolic, functional, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Reports primary results of a prospective randomized noninferiority trial comparing levonorgestrel and copper IUD groups, including pregnancy and adverse-event outcomes.

This double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial randomly assigned and rerandomized participants to naltrexone-bupropion or placebo and reports direct between-group comparisons of response and safety outcomes.
Case-control genetic association study comparing women with breast cancer against controls; no randomized intervention allocation or randomized-group outcome comparison is reported.
Reports primary outcomes from a multicenter randomized trial directly comparing dexamethasone with placebo, including 6-month functional outcomes, repeat surgery, and adverse events.
Reports an unplanned interim mortality analysis from a randomized clinical trial, directly comparing all-cause mortality between patients assigned to drug-coated versus uncoated devices.
Reports results from an open-label cluster-randomized human trial, directly comparing hydroxychloroquine with usual care for Covid-19 outcomes and adverse events.
Observational outbreak investigation using epidemiologic, contact-tracing, clinical, and genomic data; no prospective random allocation or comparison between randomized groups was reported.
Phase 3 human trial with 307 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to pembrolizumab or chemotherapy; it reports direct between-group comparisons for progression-free survival, response, and adverse events.
Reports a prospective randomized, placebo-controlled trial comparing convalescent plasma with placebo, with between-group results for clinical status, mortality, antibody titers, and adverse events.
Reports interim efficacy and safety results from a randomized phase 3 trial, with direct comparisons between the lorlatinib and crizotinib groups.

Reports outcomes from a multicenter double-blind trial in which patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to sotagliflozin or placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of cardiovascular endpoints and adverse events.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized-withdrawal trial reporting direct comparisons of rilonacept versus placebo for pericarditis recurrence and safety outcomes.

Reports 12-month outcomes from 303 patients randomly assigned to cryoballoon ablation or antiarrhythmic drug therapy, with direct between-group comparisons of arrhythmia recurrence and other outcomes.
This phase 2 single-group human trial reports treatment outcomes but did not randomize participants or compare randomized groups.
Reports results from a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial, with direct comparisons of clinical outcomes between the tocilizumab and placebo groups.

This long-term follow-up reports mortality and life-expectancy comparisons between surgery and usual-care groups, but the study is described only as prospective and controlled, not randomized. The only explicit random selection concerns the general-population reference sample, not treatment allocation.

Reports primary results from a prospective randomized noninferiority trial of antibiotics versus appendectomy, with direct between-group comparisons of health status, complications, and serious adverse events.
Nationwide observational register-based cohort study comparing vaccinated and unvaccinated populations; vaccination was not randomly allocated.
Reports primary cardiovascular outcomes from a multicenter, double-blind randomized trial, with direct comparisons of pooled ertugliflozin groups versus placebo.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a 26-week randomized, double-blind phase 2 trial, directly comparing participants assigned to once-weekly insulin icodec versus once-daily insulin glargine U100.
Double-blind phase 3 trial with 682 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to osimertinib or placebo; disease-free survival and other outcomes are directly compared between the randomized groups.
This phase 1 dose-escalation and expansion study reports outcomes for patients receiving sotorasib, without randomized allocation or a between-group randomized comparison.
Reports primary results from a phase 3 randomized, double-blind trial, directly comparing renal efficacy and safety outcomes between belimumab and placebo groups.

Reports primary results of a double-blind, placebo-controlled trial that randomly assigned 138 patients to continuous molgramostim, intermittent molgramostim, or placebo and directly compared efficacy and safety outcomes between randomized groups.

Reports primary results from a phase 2 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial, with direct comparisons of exacerbation outcomes, biomarkers, and safety between the two brensocatib dose groups and placebo.
Reports day-35 safety and immunogenicity results from a randomized, placebo-controlled phase 1-2 human trial, with outcomes compared across randomized vaccine, adjuvant, dose, and placebo groups.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a randomized, double-blind controlled trial of colchicine versus placebo, with direct comparisons between the randomized groups.
Randomized controlled trial assigning patients 1:1 to aspirin alone or aspirin plus clopidogrel, with direct between-group comparisons of bleeding and thromboembolic outcomes at 1 year.

The study reports outcomes comparing diet and gastric bypass groups, but the supplied abstract does not indicate random allocation; it describes matched weight loss in two intervention groups. Therefore, a randomized-group comparison is not established.
This double-blind phase 3 trial randomly assigned 65 patients to evinacumab or placebo and reports direct between-group comparisons for LDL cholesterol outcomes and adverse events.

Population-level observational analysis of SEER registry data evaluating incidence, mortality, and survival trends; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups is reported.
Population-based surveillance study of Zika virus disease and pregnancy outcomes; no prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Prospective double-blind phase 1b trial comparing TY014 with placebo; it reports between-group efficacy and safety outcomes, strongly indicating randomized allocation.
This multicenter randomized trial reports 2-year outcomes and directly compares the groups assigned to myomectomy versus uterine-artery embolization.
Pregnant women were randomly assigned to RSV vaccine or placebo, and the publication reports direct between-group comparisons of infant efficacy outcomes and maternal safety results.

This human trial randomly assigned preterm infants in a 2:1 ratio to nirsevimab or placebo and directly compared RSV-associated infection, hospitalization, and adverse-event outcomes between the randomized groups.
Reports results of a phase 3 double-blind randomized trial comparing nemolizumab with placebo, including direct between-group comparisons of efficacy and safety outcomes.

Reports results of a multicenter, double-blind randomized trial in which household contacts were assigned 1:1 to baloxavir or placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of clinical influenza, infection, and adverse events.
Reports primary outcome and adverse-event results from a randomized controlled trial directly comparing allopurinol with placebo.

Reports primary results of a human randomized trial comparing standard care plus mechanical thrombectomy with standard care alone, with direct between-group comparisons of 90-day functional and safety outcomes.

Reports results from an international randomized phase 3 trial comparing rituximab plus standard LMB chemotherapy with standard LMB chemotherapy alone, including direct between-group comparisons of event-free survival, overall survival, and adverse events.
Reports primary results from a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial, directly comparing Covid-19 incidence and adverse effects between hydroxychloroquine and placebo groups.

Phase 3 human trial with patients randomly assigned to atezolizumab plus bevacizumab or sorafenib; it reports direct between-group comparisons of overall survival, progression-free survival, and adverse events.
Prospective registry with patients receiving reused devices matched to controls receiving new devices; no randomized allocation is reported.
This open-label, single-group phase 2-3 study reports efficacy and safety outcomes for emapalumab but did not randomly allocate participants or compare randomized groups.

This is an observational registry analysis of hospitalized patients with Covid-19. It assesses associations between cardiovascular disease or medication use and mortality without randomized treatment allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.

Reports primary phase 3 trial results in which men were randomly assigned 2:1 to olaparib or physician's choice of enzalutamide/abiraterone, with direct between-group comparisons of progression-free survival, response, overall survival, patient-reported outcomes, and toxicity.
National observational surveillance study comparing fatal versus nonfatal EVALI cases reported to the CDC; no prospective random allocation or randomized-group comparison was performed.
This phase 2 human trial reports efficacy and safety results for a single KTE-X19 treatment cohort. No random allocation or comparison between randomized groups is described.

Observational surveillance study estimating national C. difficile infection trends from sampled cases and census weights; it reports no randomized treatment allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Observational analysis of hospitalization and microbiology data from 890 U.S. hospitals estimating infection incidence and trends; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Reports primary outcome and safety results from a prospective double-blind randomized trial, directly comparing liraglutide with placebo in adolescents with obesity.
The abstract reports that 777 patients were randomly assigned to invasive versus conservative strategies and directly compares primary, secondary, and safety outcomes between those randomized groups.

Reports a secondary health-status outcome from a randomized human trial, directly comparing Seattle Angina Questionnaire outcomes between participants assigned to invasive versus conservative treatment strategies.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a randomized, double-blind trial, directly comparing rivaroxaban with enoxaparin in the groups created by random allocation.
Phase 3 randomized open-label trial reporting week-48 efficacy and safety outcomes directly compared between the randomly assigned long-acting injectable and continued oral therapy groups.
Observational descriptive study of 1099 patients with laboratory-confirmed Covid-19; no prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups is reported.

Reports primary outcome and safety results from a prospective randomized 2-by-2 factorial trial, with direct comparisons of plasma exchange versus control and reduced-dose versus standard-dose glucocorticoids.
Reports primary 1-year outcomes from an international randomized trial, directly comparing patients assigned to polymer-based zotarolimus-eluting versus polymer-free drug-coated stents.
This is an individual clinical case presentation of a 74-year-old woman, not a randomized clinical trial, and it reports no randomized-group comparison.

This phase 1/2 study administered CAR-NK cells to 11 patients at three dose levels and reported safety and response outcomes, but it does not describe random allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.
Six-year follow-up reporting clinical and lung-function outcomes directly compared between the prenatal vitamin D and control groups created by the parent trial's treatment allocation.
Observational epidemiologic analysis of 425 confirmed cases estimating transmission dynamics; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Single-patient genetic and experimental case study of inherited NOS2 deficiency; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups was reported.

Double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial with random assignment to H. pylori eradication therapy or placebo; it reports and directly compares gastric cancer incidence and adverse events between the randomized groups.

Reports primary results of a multicenter randomized noninferiority trial comparing conservative with interventional management, including randomized-group comparisons for lung reexpansion, adverse events, and recurrence.
Reports primary phase 3 results from a randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled trial, with direct comparisons of clinical outcomes between teprotumumab and placebo groups.

Human cluster-randomized trial assigning schools to immediate versus delayed 4CMenB vaccination; it reports and directly compares meningococcal carriage outcomes between the randomized groups at 12 months.
This is a general review-style article on suicide epidemiology; it does not describe randomized allocation or report a comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.
Multicenter double-blind randomized trial assigning preterm infants to erythropoietin or placebo; it reports direct between-group comparisons for the primary outcome and safety outcomes.
This double-blind, placebo-controlled phase 3 trial randomly assigned patients to luspatercept or placebo and directly compared transfusion-independence outcomes between the randomized groups.
Observational difference-in-differences study comparing acquired hospitals with nonacquired control hospitals; hospital acquisition was not randomly allocated.

Protocol-specified interim overall-survival analysis of a phase 3 trial with patients randomly assigned to ribociclib or placebo plus fulvestrant; it reports direct between-group survival, progression-free survival, and safety comparisons.

This phase 2 study is explicitly described as open-label and single-group. It reports efficacy and safety outcomes for trastuzumab deruxtecan without randomized allocation or a between-group comparison.
The report describes prospective random assignment of 145 patients to early surgery or conservative care and directly compares primary and secondary clinical outcomes between those randomized groups.
Population-based surveillance report of Zika virus cases and pregnancy outcomes; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Primary results of a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial in adults, directly comparing 6-month mortality and safety outcomes between the high-dose and standard-dose rifampin groups.
Reports primary results of a randomized human trial directly comparing ketamine versus etomidate, including between-group mortality, cardiovascular collapse, and safety outcomes.
Single-arm report of two participants who both received PM359; no random allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

This primary results report describes a multicenter, double-blind randomized trial assigning patients 1:1:1 to two engasertib doses or placebo and directly compares safety and epistaxis outcomes across the randomized groups.
Interim results from a phase 3 double-blind randomized trial are reported, with direct comparisons of sibeprenlimab versus placebo for proteinuria and safety outcomes.

Reports primary results from two double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trials, with direct comparisons of triglyceride, pancreatitis, safety, and other outcomes between each randomized olezarsen group and placebo.

trial_name_or_acronym: European Randomized Study of Screening for Prostate Cancer (ERSPC)
brief_rationale: This 23-year follow-up reports prostate cancer mortality and incidence outcomes directly comparing men randomized to PSA screening versus control.

Phase 3 human trial with 1:1:1 random allocation; this prespecified interim analysis reports direct outcome and safety comparisons between the trastuzumab deruxtecan-plus-pertuzumab and THP randomized groups.
Reports primary results from a pragmatic randomized controlled trial, directly comparing 30-day mortality and adverse events between glucocorticoid and standard-care groups.
Long-term follow-up results from a randomized human trial directly compare nivolumab with ipilimumab on recurrence-free, distant metastasis-free, and overall survival and safety outcomes.

Reports primary results of a cluster-randomized human trial in which villages were assigned to placebo, twice-yearly azithromycin, or quarterly azithromycin, with mortality and adverse events directly compared across randomized groups.

Reports primary results of a prospective two-group cluster-randomized human trial, with direct intervention-versus-control comparisons for laboratory-confirmed disease, mosquito density, community effects, and adverse events.

This is explicitly an observational electronic-health-record cohort study comparing veterans who chose to receive Covid-19 plus influenza vaccines with those receiving influenza vaccine only; no randomized treatment allocation is reported.

Reports primary outcome results from a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled human trial, with direct comparisons of aspirin versus placebo for cancer recurrence, disease-free survival, and adverse events.

This is a retrospective outbreak epidemiology and clinical case-series analysis. Although investigational treatments and a phase 2 vaccine trial are mentioned, no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Laboratory investigation of serum samples from nine patients with HIT; no prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Reports 12-month clinical and bleeding outcomes from a multicenter randomized trial, directly comparing the aspirin-withdrawal P2Y12 monotherapy group with the dual antiplatelet therapy group.
Double-blind, double-dummy trial randomly assigned adults 1:1 to aficamten or metoprolol and reports direct between-group comparisons for the primary, secondary, and safety outcomes at 24 weeks.

Reports primary clinical outcomes from a prospective, individually randomized trial comparing RSVpreF vaccination with no vaccine in older adults, including hospitalization and serious adverse-event results between randomized groups.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a multicenter randomized superiority trial, directly comparing the high-normal potassium strategy with standard care among 1,200 randomized participants.

This reports outcomes from a reproductive care pathway in 22 women receiving pronuclear transfer, including eight live births. No randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is described.
This is a four-patient, single-arm gene-therapy study. It reports clinical outcomes but provides no randomized allocation or between-group comparison.

This open-label phase 2 study administered the same bevacizumab–erlotinib combination to all participants and reports outcomes by hereditary versus sporadic disease subtype, not by randomized intervention groups. No randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

This phase 3 trial randomly assigned patients to three treatment groups and reports extended follow-up results with direct randomized-group comparisons for MRD, progression-free survival, overall survival, and sudden death.
Reports primary results from a prospective randomized trial comparing three assigned rehydration strategies, including mortality and serious adverse events between randomized groups.
Reports primary and secondary outcomes from an international human clinical trial in which patients were randomly assigned to PAV+ or PSV, with direct comparisons between the randomized groups.

Reports primary results from a multinational randomized trial of ANH versus usual care in adults undergoing cardiac surgery, with direct between-group comparisons of transfusion and clinical outcomes.
Reports primary outcome and safety results from a prospective 1:1:1 randomized trial, with direct comparisons among the finerenone, empagliflozin, and combination groups.
Observational outbreak investigation of reported diphtheria cases and bacterial isolates; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Phase 3 human trial with random assignment to MRD-guided consolidation strategies. It reports and directly compares the randomized groups on the primary MRD-negativity endpoint.

Phase 3 double-blind randomized trial reporting direct comparisons of durvalumab plus FLOT versus placebo plus FLOT for event-free survival, overall survival, pathological response, and adverse events.
Phase 3 randomized human trial reporting direct cemiplimab-versus-placebo comparisons for disease-free survival, recurrence, and safety outcomes.
Reports outcomes from an open-label randomized human trial directly comparing tenecteplase plus thrombectomy with thrombectomy alone, including efficacy and safety results by randomized group.
Reports primary 96-week efficacy and safety results from an open-label randomized 2-by-4 factorial trial, with direct comparisons between the randomized ART backbone and anchor-drug groups.
This phase 2 randomized, placebo-controlled human trial reports 8-week efficacy and safety outcomes and directly compares multiple randomized oveporexton groups with placebo.

Observational natural-experiment analysis of Medicare data comparing beneficiaries by calendar timing of Medicaid disenrollment; participants were not prospectively randomly allocated to subsidy-coverage groups.

This phase 2b double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reports efficacy and safety outcomes directly comparing two efruxifermin dose groups with the randomized placebo group at weeks 36 and 96.
This is a single-arm, dose-ranging study in which all 21 patients received huCART19-IL18. It reports safety and efficacy outcomes but no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Prospective open-label studies and expanded-access programs compared treated patients with an untreated natural-history cohort; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a multicenter, double-blind randomized trial, with direct comparisons of two lorundrostat groups against the randomized placebo group.
This multiyear follow-up reports outcomes for a single cohort of 15 participants who all received fidanacogene elaparvovec. No randomized allocation or between-group comparison is described.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting direct comparisons between tolebrutinib and placebo for disability progression and adverse events.

Phase 3 human trial with random assignment to two upadacitinib doses or placebo; it reports and directly compares randomized groups on sustained remission, secondary efficacy endpoints, and safety outcomes.

This is a longitudinal retrospective cohort study assessing the association between wealth quartile and mortality. It reports no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups.

This is a prospective population-based cohort study estimating scrub typhus incidence and epidemiologic associations. It reports no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from two phase 3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trials, with direct comparisons of remibrutinib versus placebo on UAS7 and adverse events.
Double-blind randomized noninferiority trial reporting seroconversion and adverse-event results directly compared across the standard-dose and three randomized fractional-dose groups.
Single-patient xenotransplantation case report with no random allocation or randomized-group comparison.
Prospective randomized human trial reporting direct outcome comparisons between EVT plus usual care and usual care alone, including 90-day functional outcome, mortality, and hemorrhage.
Observational epidemiologic analysis of reported mpox cases and deaths; there was no prospective random allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Phase 3 randomized controlled noninferiority trial reporting efficacy and safety results with direct comparisons of five randomized oral regimens against standard therapy.

Prospective cancer-screening cohort evaluating diagnostic yield and test performance after unusual or nonreportable cfDNA results; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Reports results of a double-blind randomized controlled trial comparing levofloxacin with placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of tuberculosis incidence and adverse events.
Phase 3 randomized trial reporting direct comparisons of disease-free survival and adverse outcomes between chemotherapy alone and chemotherapy plus blinatumomab.

This phase 1b-2 human study reports efficacy and safety results for a single obe-cel treatment group/cohorts, with outcomes tested against prespecified null hypotheses. No randomized allocation or direct comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized trial reporting outcomes and directly comparing HIV incidence and safety between the lenacapavir and F/TDF randomized groups.
Reports primary outcome and safety results from a multicenter randomized trial, directly comparing the embolization and usual-care groups created by 1:1 random allocation.

This multicenter noninferiority trial randomly assigned hospitalized patients to 7 versus 14 days of antibiotic treatment and directly compared 90-day mortality and other outcomes between the randomized groups.

This phase 1 open-label, single-arm trial administered nexiguran ziclumeran to all 36 patients and reports within-group changes from baseline; no random allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

Reports primary outcome and adverse-event results from a human trial that randomly assigned patients 1:1 to catheter ablation or antiarrhythmic drug therapy, with direct comparison of the randomized groups.

This phase 2 dose-finding study assigned children to five sequential dose cohorts rather than randomized comparator groups. It reports outcomes within cohorts and against an untreated reference population, with no randomized between-group comparison.

This later 3-year analysis of a phase 3 double-blind randomized controlled trial reports weight, diabetes incidence, and safety outcomes with direct comparisons of the randomized tirzepatide dose groups versus placebo.
Reports results from a randomized clinical trial directly comparing intraosseous versus intravenous vascular access, including primary and secondary outcomes between the randomized groups.

The report describes prospective random assignment of 400 patients to transcatheter tricuspid-valve replacement plus medical therapy versus medical therapy alone and directly compares 1-year efficacy and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Primary results of a prospective randomized human trial comparing early TAVR with clinical surveillance; outcomes are reported directly by randomized group, including the primary composite endpoint.
This is a single-arm phase 2–3 study in which all 32 patients received eli-cel. It reports efficacy, safety, and long-term follow-up outcomes but no randomized allocation or between-group comparison.
Reports primary results from a randomized, placebo-controlled trial of pomalidomide versus placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of epistaxis severity, quality of life, and adverse events.
Phase 2 human trial with random assignment to three axatilimab dose groups; response, symptom, and safety outcomes are reported separately for and directly compared across the randomized groups.
Phase 3 randomized trial reporting direct comparisons between the durvalumab and comparison groups for event-free survival, overall survival, adverse events, and cystectomy rates.

Phase 3 trial with 866 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to trastuzumab deruxtecan or physician's-choice chemotherapy; progression-free survival and safety outcomes are directly compared between randomized groups.
Reports primary 1-year outcomes from a multicenter randomized controlled trial directly comparing patients assigned to 24 versus 15 hours per day of long-term oxygen therapy.
Phase 3 randomized controlled trial reporting efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons of the argatroban and eptifibatide groups against placebo.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from an international double-blind trial that randomly assigned patients 1:1 to finerenone or placebo and directly compared outcomes between the randomized groups.

This phase 2 study was explicitly open-label and single-group, with outcomes assessed against a historical benchmark. It did not randomly allocate participants or report a comparison between randomized groups.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized controlled trial reporting HIV incidence and safety outcomes, including direct comparisons among the randomized lenacapavir, F/TAF, and F/TDF groups.
Phase 3b randomized controlled trial reporting direct risankizumab-versus-ustekinumab comparisons for clinical and endoscopic remission and adverse events.

Observational genetic cohort analysis comparing PSEN1 E280A carriers with versus without APOE3 Christchurch heterozygosity; no prospective randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
This is a single-center, single-arm phase 1b–2 study of the ViPOR regimen. It reports treatment outcomes but no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from an international randomized trial directly comparing pantoprazole with matching placebo in critically ill adults undergoing invasive ventilation.
Phase 3 human trial with random assignment to isatuximab plus VRd versus VRd alone; it reports direct between-group comparisons for progression-free survival, response, MRD status, and safety.
Phase 3 human trial reporting outcomes for 423 randomly assigned patients, with direct comparison of event-free survival and adverse events between the neoadjuvant and adjuvant groups.
Phase 3 human trial with adults randomly assigned to crinecerfont or placebo; it reports and directly compares efficacy and adverse-event outcomes between the randomized groups.

This is a multicenter observational biomarker study with an experimental mouse model. It reports associations between antinephrin autoantibodies and disease activity but no prospective randomized human allocation or randomized-group comparison.
Reports primary results from a prospective randomized human trial comparing semaglutide with placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of kidney, cardiovascular, mortality, and safety outcomes.

The abstract reports a multicenter randomized controlled trial in which 508 participants were assigned to pulmonologist-directed intervention or usual care, with direct between-group comparisons of health care utilization, quality of life, symptoms, lung function, and adverse events.
This is a prospective single-group human study comparing safety and performance outcomes with prespecified performance goals; there was no randomized allocation or between-group comparison.

Reports primary clinical outcomes from a prospective 1:1 randomized trial directly comparing thrombectomy plus medical care with medical care alone, including functional outcome, mortality, and safety results.
This is an open-label, single-group phase 3 study reporting exa-cel outcomes. There was no randomized allocation or between-group comparison.

Phase 3 human trial with 1:1 random assignment to adjuvant alectinib or platinum-based chemotherapy; it reports direct between-group comparisons for disease-free survival, CNS disease-free survival, and safety.
Reports primary 1-year outcomes from a randomized noninferiority trial, directly comparing TAVI and SAVR groups for death, stroke, and procedural complications.

Phase 3 double-blind trial with patients randomly assigned to two olezarsen doses or placebo; it reports and directly compares triglyceride, apolipoprotein C-III, pancreatitis, and safety outcomes between randomized groups.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled trial, directly comparing empagliflozin with placebo after acute myocardial infarction.

Reports phase 3 trial results, including a genuinely randomized comparison in APPLY-PNH between switching to iptacopan and continuing anti-C5 therapy, with direct between-group outcome results. APPOINT-PNH was single-group, but the publication remains eligible because it reports the randomized comparative trial.
Prospective diagnostic test validation comparing cfDNA test performance with screening colonoscopy; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups is reported.
First-in-human open-label study in which three participants all received CARv3-TEAM-E T cells; no random allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

Phase 3 trial with 886 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to enfortumab vedotin plus pembrolizumab or platinum-based chemotherapy; it directly compares progression-free survival, overall survival, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Reports results of a multicenter randomized noninferiority trial in 700 patients, directly comparing pelvic recurrence and adverse outcomes between simple and radical hysterectomy groups.
Reports a prospective randomized placebo-controlled trial in which participants were assigned 2:1 to omalizumab or placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of efficacy and safety outcomes.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 3 randomized, double-blind noninferiority trial, with direct outcome comparisons between the benralizumab and mepolizumab groups.
Reports results from the randomized, double-blind withdrawal phase of a human phase 2 trial, directly comparing rusfertide with placebo; response was 60% versus 17% (P=0.002).
Single-infant case report describing treatment with high-dose ERT, rituximab, and HSCT; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Phase 2 human trial with patients randomly assigned to five JNJ-77242113 dose groups or placebo; it reports and directly compares efficacy and adverse-event outcomes across the randomized groups.

This phase 1 dose-escalation study administered three NTLA-2002 dose levels to small cohorts, but the abstract does not indicate randomized allocation. Results are primarily within-group changes from baseline rather than comparisons between groups created by randomization.
Observational analysis of 2020–2021 national insurance claims comparing drug-price markups across provider types; no prospective random allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

Reports results from a phase 2-3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial, with direct comparisons between the simnotrelvir-plus-ritonavir and placebo groups for symptom resolution, viral load, and adverse events.
This subtrial reports fracture outcomes from a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial, directly comparing participants assigned to testosterone versus placebo gel.
Infants were prospectively randomized 1:1 to nirsevimab or standard care, and the publication directly compares hospitalization, severe RSV disease, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Single-patient case report of liver transplantation for Mahvash disease; no randomized allocation or between-group comparison is reported.

Reports prospective head-to-head results comparing two diagnostic stimulation tests, with all patients undergoing both tests. The abstract does not state that test order or treatment sequence was randomly allocated, so genuine randomization cannot be established from the supplied text.

Phase 3 human trial with random assignment to restrictive versus liberal transfusion strategies; it reports and directly compares 30-day myocardial infarction and mortality outcomes between randomized groups.
Reports primary cardiovascular and safety results from a double-blind randomized trial, directly comparing semaglutide with placebo.

Phase 3 human trial with 1:1 random assignment to osimertinib plus chemotherapy versus osimertinib monotherapy; it reports direct between-group comparisons for progression-free survival, response, and safety.
Phase 3 human trial with patients randomly assigned to sparsentan or irbesartan; the report directly compares randomized groups on proteinuria, eGFR, and safety outcomes through 108 weeks.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized trial reporting 12-month outcomes directly comparing patisiran with placebo in 360 patients.
Phase 3 randomized, placebo-controlled human trial reporting direct teplizumab-versus-placebo comparisons for β-cell function, clinical secondary endpoints, and adverse events.
Primary results of a randomized open-label trial in infants, directly comparing continuous antibiotic prophylaxis with no treatment on UTI, kidney, microbiologic, and safety outcomes.
This phase 1–2 study treated three participants with autologous OTQ923 and reports single-arm safety and clinical outcomes. No random allocation or comparison between randomized groups is described.

This is a pooled observational analysis of 112 cohort studies using Cox regression to assess associations between risk factors and cardiovascular outcomes. It reports no randomized treatment allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Phase 2 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons among randomized retatrutide dose groups and placebo.

Reports primary and secondary outcomes from a phase 3a trial in which adults were randomly assigned 1:1 to weekly insulin icodec or daily insulin glargine U100, with direct between-group efficacy and safety comparisons.
Reports primary results from a multicenter randomized trial of video versus direct laryngoscopy, with direct between-group comparisons of first-attempt intubation success and complications.
This pragmatic randomized controlled trial assigned 1360 patients to high-dose hemodiafiltration or conventional high-flux hemodialysis and directly compared mortality between the randomized groups.

Adults resuscitated after out-of-hospital cardiac arrest were randomly assigned 1:1 to mild hypercapnia or normocapnia, and neurologic outcomes, mortality, and adverse events were directly compared between the randomized groups.
Case-based characterization and treatment of two children with rare leptin variants; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Phase 1 single-arm case series of BE-CAR7 treatment in three children. It reports safety and clinical outcomes but no randomized allocation or between-group comparison.

This double-blind phase 3 trial randomly assigned 331 patients to vorasidenib or placebo and directly compared progression-free survival, time to next intervention, and adverse events between the randomized groups.
Phase 3 randomized human trial reporting direct comparisons of cilta-cel versus standard care for progression-free survival, response, mortality, and adverse events.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from three phase 3 randomized trials, with direct comparisons of upadacitinib groups versus placebo for induction and maintenance outcomes.
Reports primary outcome results from a human trial with participants randomly assigned 1:1 to early versus later anticoagulation, with direct outcome comparisons between the randomized groups.
Prospective multicenter single-group device study reporting safety and performance against prespecified performance goals; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from two phase 2a randomized controlled trials, with direct comparisons of cure rates and adverse events among randomized emodepside dose groups, albendazole, and placebo.

Phase 2a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting outcomes directly compared between randomized peresolimab and placebo groups, including DAS28-CRP, ACR responses, and adverse events.

Observational analysis of Medicare claims from a random sample of beneficiaries, comparing outcomes by race and ethnicity. Random sampling is not randomized treatment allocation, and no randomized intervention-group comparison is reported.

Phase 3 human trial with explicit 1:1:1:1 random assignment to four treatment groups; it reports and directly compares minimal residual disease, progression-free survival, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

This is a longitudinal observational cohort study of patients with idiopathic CD4 lymphocytopenia. It reports prognostic associations and clinical characteristics but no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups.

Reports primary results from a prospective 1:1 randomized trial comparing FTD-TPI plus bevacizumab with FTD-TPI alone, with direct between-group comparisons of overall survival, progression-free survival, safety, and performance-status worsening.
Multicenter double-blind trial randomly assigned transfusion recipients to red cells from male versus female donors and directly compared survival and mortality between the randomized groups.
Reports primary efficacy, quality-of-life, and safety results from a randomized, placebo-controlled phase 2 trial, with direct comparisons of two dersimelagon dose groups against placebo.
Observational analysis of Medicare data estimating associations between annual PM2.5 exposure and mortality; no prospective randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

Prospective randomized case-crossover trial in 100 adults reporting direct within-participant comparisons of clinical and behavioral outcomes during randomly assigned caffeinated-coffee versus caffeine-avoidance periods.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized controlled trial reporting direct hydrocortisone-versus-placebo comparisons for 28-day mortality and other clinical outcomes.

Five-year follow-up results from a randomized human trial are reported, with direct comparisons of hospitalization, mortality, and composite outcomes between the device-plus-medical-therapy and medical-therapy-alone groups.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial, with direct comparisons between the bempedoic acid and placebo groups.

This human clinical trial randomly assigned older adults to antidepressant augmentation or switching strategies in two steps and reports direct between-group comparisons of well-being, remission, and falls.

Observational policy-effect study using administrative claims to compare workers in metropolitan areas exposed versus unexposed to paid-sick-leave mandates; no prospective random allocation is reported.

This open-label, single-arm phase 3 study compares outcomes after gene therapy with the same participants' lead-in prophylaxis period; it does not report prospective random allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.
Reports phase 2-3 trial results after children were randomly assigned 2:1 to BNT162b2 or placebo, with direct between-group safety, immunogenicity, and efficacy comparisons.

Phase 3 randomized trial with patients assigned to whole-breast irradiation or no irradiation; the publication directly compares recurrence and survival outcomes between randomized groups after a median 9.1 years of follow-up.
Reports results of a phase 2 double-blind RCT in which patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to difelikefalin or placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of itch outcomes and adverse events.

Prospective randomized trial assigning brain-dead kidney donors to hypothermia, machine perfusion, or both; it reports and directly compares delayed graft function, graft survival, and adverse events across the randomized groups.
Phase 1–2 single-arm study of lentiviral gene therapy in 10 infants; it reports clinical outcomes but no random allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

This phase 1–2 study reports outcomes from selpercatinib-treated cohorts but does not describe random allocation or a comparison between randomized intervention groups.
This is a human genetic sequencing and case-control analysis of stillbirths. It reports no prospective randomized intervention allocation or comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.

Primary results of a prospective two-group noninferiority clinical trial comparing subcutaneous versus transvenous ICD assignment, with direct between-group analyses of the primary and secondary outcomes.
Phase 3 human trial with children randomly assigned to vitamin D3 or placebo; the publication reports and directly compares primary, secondary, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

This human microbiota/proteomic study reports correlations and comparisons with healthy children, plus experiments in gnotobiotic mice. It does not establish random allocation or report outcomes compared between randomized intervention groups.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a randomized, placebo-controlled, double-blind human trial, directly comparing ticagrelor plus aspirin with placebo plus aspirin.

This is a two-patient, single-arm treatment study with comparisons to untreated patients or controls for selected measurements. No prospective random allocation or direct comparison between randomized groups is reported.

Phase 1-2 human trial with participants randomly assigned 3:1 to tofersen or placebo. It reports safety, pharmacokinetic, biomarker, and clinical results, including direct comparisons between randomized tofersen dose groups and placebo.
Double-blind randomized noninferiority trial in children reporting direct comparisons of treatment failure, relapse, and serious adverse events between the 3-day and 5-day amoxicillin groups.
Descriptive statewide surveillance study of hospitalized MIS-C cases; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups was reported.
Reports results from a multicenter cluster-randomized crossover trial, directly comparing serious medical error rates between the randomized resident physician schedules.
Single-patient case report describing sequential treatment with interferon-γ and dupilumab; no randomized allocation or between-group comparison is reported.
Observational cohort study comparing suicide and mortality among handgun owners versus nonowners; handgun acquisition was not randomly assigned, so no randomized-group comparison is reported.
This open-label phase 2 study administered tepotinib to a single cohort and reports efficacy and safety outcomes without randomized allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.
Phase 3 human trial with patients randomly assigned to relugolix or leuprolide; the report directly compares randomized groups on testosterone suppression, recovery, and safety outcomes.

This open-label phase 2 trial randomly assigned patients to trastuzumab deruxtecan or physician's-choice chemotherapy and directly compared objective response, survival, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Reports primary results of a human randomized trial comparing thrombectomy alone with thrombectomy preceded by intravenous alteplase, including direct between-group comparisons of 90-day functional outcome, reperfusion, and mortality.
Population-based matched case-control study using regional health care databases; drug exposure was not randomly allocated, and no randomized-group comparison was reported.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a multicenter randomized phase 3 trial, with direct comparisons between the ruxolitinib and randomized control groups.
Retrospective diagnostic-performance study of a deep-learning system using collected fundus photographs; no prospective randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Case series describing coagulopathy and antiphospholipid antibodies in three critically ill patients with COVID-19; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a randomized 1:1 trial directly comparing oral anticoagulation alone versus oral anticoagulation plus clopidogrel after TAVI.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a randomized trial directly comparing apixaban with dalteparin in patients with cancer-associated venous thromboembolism.
Epidemiologic outbreak investigation with case tracing and descriptive outcomes; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
This phase 3 trial reports a randomized 3:1 comparison of fostemsavir versus placebo and presents between-group HIV-1 RNA outcomes at day 8, including a statistically significant treatment effect.

This is an observational nationwide registry study comparing aspirin initiators with nonusers using propensity-score weighting. Aspirin exposure was not randomly allocated, so the reported outcomes are not a randomized-group comparison.

Phase 3 trial with participants randomly assigned 1:1 to long-acting injectable therapy or continued oral therapy; week-48 efficacy and safety outcomes are directly compared between randomized groups.

This is a descriptive report of a patient with germline VHL deficiency and associated molecular and physiological findings. It does not describe randomized allocation or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

Reports results from a multicenter randomized noninferiority trial in newborns, directly comparing lower versus traditional glucose treatment-threshold groups on 18-month psychomotor outcomes and other endpoints.

This reports observational human cohort analyses of suPAR levels and acute kidney injury, plus experimental mouse and cell studies. No prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized human groups is reported.
Five-year follow-up results from a randomized human trial directly compare TAVR with surgical aortic-valve replacement on mortality, disabling stroke, and other outcomes.

This is an observational evaluation of England's national 4CMenB immunization program using surveillance data and historical/nonequivalent cohort comparisons. It does not report randomized allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.
Single-patient case report describing ruxolitinib treatment and recovery; no randomized allocation or between-group comparison is reported.
Reports primary results from 800 patients randomly assigned to the Coalition care-transition program or usual care, with a direct between-group comparison of 180-day readmission rates.

Reports results of a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled dose-ranging trial in 286 patients, with direct comparisons of lipoprotein(a) change and safety outcomes between randomized APO(a)-LRx dose groups and placebo.

Observational case–comparator analysis of bronchoalveolar-lavage samples from patients with EVALI and healthy participants; no randomized intervention allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.

Reports primary cardiovascular outcomes from a double-blind trial that randomly assigned patients 1:1 to tirzepatide or dulaglutide and directly compared the randomized groups.

Phase 3 human trial with explicit random assignment of 587 patients; it reports and directly compares progression-free survival, response, minimal residual disease, and adverse events between the randomized treatment groups.

Reports results from a human trial in which girls were randomly assigned to four HPV vaccine dose/type groups. It directly compares infection outcomes between the randomized one-dose and two-dose groups and demonstrates noninferiority.
Phase 2a double-blind randomized trial reporting outcomes by assigned mosnodenvir dose and placebo, including a direct high-dose-versus-placebo comparison of the primary DENV-3 RNA endpoint.

Phase 3 human trial with 18,476 adults randomly assigned to a modRNA influenza vaccine or licensed control vaccine; efficacy, immunogenicity, reactogenicity, and safety outcomes are directly compared between randomized groups.
This ascending-dose phase 1 study treated all 15 participants with a single dose of CTX310 at varying dose levels. No random allocation or randomized comparator-group comparison is reported.
Reports primary 12-month results of a multicenter randomized trial, directly comparing NOAC monotherapy with NOAC plus clopidogrel on clinical and bleeding outcomes.
Prespecified interim results from a phase 3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial are reported, with direct atacicept-versus-placebo comparisons for proteinuria and adverse events.

Phase 3 randomized trial reporting 10-year outcomes with direct comparisons between chest-wall irradiation and no-irradiation groups, including overall survival, recurrence, disease-free survival, and adverse events.

Reports clinical outcomes from a prospective cluster-randomized trial in which ICUs were assigned to SDD or standard care, with direct comparisons between randomized groups for mortality, infections, antimicrobial resistance, and adverse events.

This open-label, multicohort phase 1-2 study gave sevabertinib to all participants; cohorts were defined by prior therapy rather than random allocation. It reports single-arm cohort outcomes without a randomized-group comparison.
Long-term outcomes are reported for a single treated cohort receiving lentiviral gene therapy. No randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is described.
Phase 3 human trial with participants randomly assigned 1:1 to telitacicept or placebo; it reports direct between-group comparisons of efficacy and adverse-event outcomes at 52 weeks.

This multicenter randomized noninferiority trial reports direct outcome comparisons between the biopsy-only and lymphadenectomy groups, including disease-free survival, cancer-specific survival, recurrence, and surgical complications.
This open-label, single-group first-in-human study reports efficacy and safety outcomes after DB-OTO treatment but did not randomly allocate participants or compare randomized groups.
This phase 1 open-label, single-arm study reports outcomes for 36 patients who all received nexiguran ziclumeran; no randomized allocation or between-group comparison is described.

Double-blind, randomized, placebo-controlled human trial reporting direct comparisons between the open-shunt and placebo valve-setting groups for gait, secondary clinical outcomes, and adverse events.

Protocol-specified final overall survival analysis of a phase 3 randomized trial; it reports direct outcome and safety comparisons between the randomized amivantamab-lazertinib and osimertinib groups.

Reports primary 1-year outcomes from a human trial that randomly assigned patients 1:1 to ticagrelor plus aspirin or aspirin alone and directly compared cardiovascular and bleeding outcomes between the randomized groups.
This double-blind randomized human trial assigned 600 patients to apixaban or placebo and reports direct between-group comparisons of recurrent VTE, bleeding, mortality, and adverse events.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a multicenter randomized trial, directly comparing P2Y12-inhibitor monotherapy with continued dual antiplatelet therapy between the randomized groups.

Reports results from a prospective randomized controlled trial comparing high-dose versus standard-dose influenza vaccine in older adults, with hospitalization, mortality, and safety outcomes presented by randomized group.
Reports primary 48-week results from a phase 3 double-blind randomized trial, with direct outcome comparisons between mavacamten and placebo groups.

Reports results of an open-label randomized human trial directly comparing beta-blocker therapy with no beta-blocker therapy, including primary, component, and safety outcomes between randomized groups.
Reports primary outcome and safety results from a double-blind trial that randomly assigned patients 1:1 to digitoxin or placebo and directly compares outcomes between the randomized groups.
This multicenter randomized human trial reports 1-year clinical outcomes and directly compares the multidomain rehabilitation and usual-care groups created by random allocation.

Reports primary results from a multicenter randomized controlled trial, with direct comparisons of mortality, blood pressure, medication use, and adverse events between the step-down and usual-care groups.

This open-label, single-arm study reports outcomes after risdiplam treatment and compares them descriptively with untreated natural-history data; there was no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison.

Primary results of an open-label randomized noninferiority trial. The abstract directly compares treatment failure, mortality, secondary pneumonic plague, and adverse events between the ciprofloxacin monotherapy and aminoglycoside-ciprofloxacin randomized groups.
Reports primary outcome and safety results from a human cluster-randomized trial, directly comparing clusters assigned to ivermectin versus albendazole.

This is a single-case report describing on-table reanimation and transplantation of a pediatric DCD heart, with adverse events reported. There is no randomized allocation or between-group comparison.
Phase 2 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting week-52 efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons between randomized maridebart cafraglutide dose groups and placebo.

Phase 3 human trial with participants randomly assigned 1:1 to perioperative pembrolizumab plus standard care or standard care alone; it directly compares event-free survival and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a cluster-randomized crossover trial, directly comparing hospital-wide lactated Ringer's solution with normal saline.
Patients were randomly assigned to regional nodal irradiation or no irradiation, and the publication directly compares recurrence, survival, and safety outcomes between these randomized groups.

Planned overall-survival follow-up from a phase 3 trial that randomly assigned patients to nivolumab plus chemotherapy or chemotherapy alone and directly compares survival between those randomized groups.
Final overall-survival analysis of a phase 3 double-blind randomized trial, directly comparing efficacy and safety outcomes between the inavolisib and placebo groups.

Reports clinical outcomes from a 1:1 randomized comparison of switching to camizestrant versus continuing an aromatase inhibitor, including progression-free survival, quality of life, and adverse events between groups.
Phase 3 human trial with participants randomly assigned to elinzanetant or placebo-elinzanetant; the report directly compares randomized groups for vasomotor symptom outcomes and adverse events.

Phase 3b human trial with participants randomly assigned 1:1 to as-needed albuterol-budesonide or albuterol alone; the report directly compares severe exacerbations, glucocorticoid exposure, and adverse events between randomized groups.

This multicenter randomized parallel-group trial reports and directly compares diagnostic accuracy and complications between patients assigned to navigational bronchoscopy versus transthoracic needle biopsy.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a randomized, placebo-controlled human trial, with direct comparisons between the obicetrapib and placebo groups.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting direct mepolizumab-versus-placebo comparisons for exacerbations, quality of life, symptoms, and adverse events.
This is a genetic and mechanistic study of families with erythrocytosis, patient-derived cells, and biological samples. It reports no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

This phase 2 study treated all participants with neoadjuvant dostarlimab and reports outcomes by tumor-site cohorts; no random allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups is described.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from two phase 3 trials in which participants were randomly assigned 1:1 to tolebrutinib or teriflunomide, with direct comparisons between randomized groups.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled human trial reporting direct inebilizumab-versus-placebo comparisons for efficacy and safety outcomes.
This is a genetic case series of 129 infant probands with supporting cell and zebrafish experiments. It reports no randomized intervention allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Reports results of a prospective randomized human trial comparing alteplase with standard medical treatment, including between-group efficacy and safety outcomes at 90 days.
Reports primary outcome results from a randomized controlled trial of TAVI with versus without cerebral embolic protection, with direct comparisons between the randomized groups.

This randomized, double-blind trial reports direct comparisons between the reduced-dose and full-dose apixaban groups for recurrent venous thromboembolism, clinically relevant bleeding, and mortality.
Adults were randomly assigned to tezepelumab or placebo, and the report presents direct between-group comparisons for coprimary, secondary, and safety-related clinical outcomes at 52 weeks.

Reports primary outcome results from a prospective stepped-wedge cluster-randomized study at 30 facilities, comparing outcomes across randomized implementation conditions and finding reduced perinatal mortality after program implementation.

Reports results of a human randomized trial comparing EVT plus best medical treatment with best medical treatment alone, including 90-day disability, mortality, and safety outcomes between randomized groups.

Phase 3 multicenter trial with 1:1 randomized allocation to FLOT perioperative chemotherapy or preoperative chemoradiotherapy; it directly compares overall survival, progression-free survival, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Prespecified long-term analysis of a phase 3 trial that randomly assigned patients to T-DM1 or trastuzumab and directly compares invasive disease-free survival, overall survival, and adverse events between the randomized groups.
