Phase 3 trial with prospective random assignment; this prespecified interim primary analysis directly compares progression-free survival and adverse events between the nivolumab-plus-ipilimumab and chemotherapy groups.
This is a single-patient case report describing fatal T-cell lymphoma after CAR T-cell therapy, with molecular analyses; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.

Prospective multicenter trial with patients randomly assigned to embolization plus surgery or surgery alone; it reports direct between-group comparisons of recurrence/reoperation, functional deterioration, mortality, and adverse events.

This prospective nationwide screening study reports feasibility, acceptability, psychosocial outcomes, and reproductive choices, but does not describe random allocation or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a prospective randomized comparison of adjunctive middle meningeal artery embolization versus standard treatment alone, with outcomes directly compared between randomized groups.

Reports primary outcomes from an international double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial of 731 patients, with direct comparisons between tirzepatide and placebo for cardiovascular, heart-failure, health-status, and safety outcomes.
Reports primary outcome and safety results from a multicenter randomized 2-by-2 factorial trial, directly comparing patients assigned to spironolactone versus placebo.
Reports results from a multicenter randomized trial directly comparing intraosseous-first versus intravenous-first strategies, including 30-day survival and secondary clinical outcomes.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized trial reporting direct comparisons of progression-free survival, response, and adverse events between the inavolisib and placebo groups.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized controlled trial reporting a prespecified interim analysis with direct atrasentan-versus-placebo comparisons for proteinuria and adverse events.
Long-term post-trial follow-up of a randomized empagliflozin-versus-placebo trial; it reports clinical outcomes directly compared according to the original randomized groups.

This is a multicenter observational cohort study of kidney-transplant biopsy specimens. It assesses associations between pathological phenotypes and outcomes without randomized treatment allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.
Case series of three children with de novo CHASERR deletions and patient-derived cellular analyses; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
The abstract explicitly describes an observational study comparing recipients according to whether deceased donors had HIV; it does not report prospective random allocation to donor groups.
Phase 3 randomized human trial reporting direct comparisons of progression-free survival and adverse outcomes between the N+AVD and BV+AVD randomized groups.
Follow-up safety analysis of patients who received eli-cel, reporting hematologic cancers and molecular findings. No randomized allocation or between-group comparison is described.
Reports primary results of a prospective randomized trial comparing tulisokibart with placebo, including between-group clinical remission and adverse-event outcomes.
Four-year follow-up results from a human randomized trial directly compare cancer detection and adverse-event outcomes between the MRI-targeted biopsy and systematic biopsy groups.

This phase 2 double-blind trial randomly assigned 187 patients to three ponsegromab dose groups or placebo and reports direct between-group comparisons for weight, symptoms, physical activity, and adverse events.

Reports phase 3 trial results in 574 patients randomly assigned to preoperative chemoradiotherapy plus perioperative chemotherapy versus perioperative chemotherapy alone, with direct between-group comparisons of survival, pathological response, and toxicity outcomes.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from two phase 3A randomized, placebo-controlled trials, with direct comparisons of depemokimab versus placebo for exacerbations and other outcomes.

This is an observational surveillance and pathogen-discovery study with laboratory and animal-model investigations. It reports no prospective randomized allocation of human participants and no comparison between randomized groups.
Phase 3 double-blind trial randomly assigned patients 1:1 to asundexian or apixaban and reports direct between-group comparisons of efficacy, bleeding, and adverse-event outcomes.

Phase 3 human trial with 75 patients randomly assigned to two plozasiran doses or placebo; it reports and directly compares triglyceride, pancreatitis, and safety outcomes across the randomized groups.
Reports primary 30-day outcomes from an open-label randomized noninferiority trial, directly comparing continuation versus interruption of oral anticoagulation in 858 patients undergoing TAVI.
Reports results of a prospective 1:1 randomized trial comparing PCI with conservative treatment in patients undergoing TAVI, including primary and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Reports primary mortality and serious-adverse-event results from a prospective cluster-randomized trial, with direct comparisons among communities assigned to child azithromycin, infant azithromycin, or placebo.
Phase 2–3 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons of both nirmatrelvir-ritonavir groups against placebo.
Single-patient case report of C1 inhibitor normalization after liver transplantation; no randomized allocation or between-group comparison is reported.

Phase 3 human trial with 502 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to tisotumab vedotin or investigator-choice chemotherapy; it directly compares randomized groups for overall survival, progression-free survival, response, and adverse events.

Phase 3 human trial with explicit random assignment to dupilumab regimens or placebo; it reports and directly compares histologic remission and secondary and safety outcomes between randomized groups.
Final long-term results from a human randomized trial directly compare dabrafenib plus trametinib with placebo for overall survival, relapse-free survival, and distant metastasis-free survival.

Reports primary outcome results from a prospective cluster-randomized trial of 67 communities, directly comparing opioid-related overdose death rates between intervention and wait-list control groups.
The abstract reports a prospective 1:1 randomized human trial of reteplase versus alteplase and directly compares efficacy and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Reports primary clinical and safety results from a prospective randomized trial directly comparing tenecteplase with standard medical treatment, including between-group 90-day disability, mortality, and hemorrhage outcomes.
This multicenter randomized human trial reports and directly compares hypoxemia and safety outcomes between the noninvasive-ventilation and oxygen-mask groups.
Single-patient case report describing CAR T-cell lymphoma after cilta-cel therapy; no randomized allocation or between-group comparison is reported.
Phase 3 randomized human trial reporting direct BPd-versus-PVd comparisons for progression-free survival, treatment response, and safety.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized three-way crossover trial reporting direct comparisons of symptom relief, attack severity, resolution, and safety between sebetralstat doses and placebo.

This translational study includes a prospective natural history cohort, animal experiments, and uncontrolled treatment of five patients with ruxolitinib. No randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Reports results from a phase 2 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial, with direct comparisons of safety, biopsy, and biomarker outcomes between the felzartamab and placebo groups.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a prospective randomized trial, directly comparing ambulance-delivered intensive blood-pressure reduction with usual care.
Prospective human trial with 1:1 random assignment to andexanet or usual care; the report directly compares efficacy and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

This phase 1-2 open-label, single-ascending-dose study treated all participants with EDIT-101 and reports within-participant changes from baseline. No randomized allocation or direct comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Phase 2 human trial reporting outcomes among children randomly assigned 1:1:1 to two L9LS doses or placebo, with direct between-group comparisons for P. falciparum infection and clinical malaria.
This multicenter factorial randomized trial reports primary outcome results directly comparing infants across each randomized intervention and comparator group.
Reports primary outcome results from an open-label cluster-randomized human trial, directly comparing hospitalization and other outcomes between the intervention and usual-care groups.
Phase 2 double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting direct comparisons between lixisenatide and placebo for motor disability outcomes and adverse events.

Reports results of a prospective 1:1 randomized noninferiority trial comparing sentinel-node biopsy only with completion axillary-lymph-node dissection. Recurrence-free survival is directly compared between randomized groups.

Reports clinical outcomes from a randomized trial of FFR-guided complete revascularization versus culprit-lesion-only PCI, with direct between-group comparisons of primary, secondary, and safety outcomes.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from an international double-blind randomized trial comparing CSL112 with matching placebo, including direct between-group endpoint and safety results.

This human dose-escalation study assigned 14 participants to four dose cohorts, but the abstract does not indicate randomized allocation. Outcomes were primarily compared with each participant's pretreatment slope rather than between randomized groups.
Population-based observational cohort using prescription-fill exposure data and propensity-score adjustment; prenatal antiseizure medication exposure was not randomly allocated.

Phase 3 human trial with pregnant women randomly assigned to RSVPreF3-Mat or placebo; the report directly compares efficacy and safety outcomes, including infant RSV disease and preterm birth, between randomized groups.
This is explicitly a prospective observational study. Outcomes were compared by detected versus undetected microplastics/nanoplastics in plaque, not between randomly allocated intervention groups.
This is an uncontrolled case series of 15 patients who all received CD19 CAR T-cell therapy. It reports follow-up efficacy and safety outcomes but no random allocation or randomized-group comparison.
Phase 3 double-blind trial with patients randomly assigned to seladelpar or placebo; it reports direct between-group comparisons for efficacy and safety outcomes.

Phase 2 double-blind randomized trial reporting clinical results with direct comparisons of two frexalimab groups against pooled matching placebo groups for primary and secondary imaging outcomes and safety.
Descriptive case series reporting clinical courses and outcomes for 13 patients in a nosocomial Fusarium meningitis outbreak; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Phase 3 human trial with participants randomly assigned to resmetirom 80 mg, resmetirom 100 mg, or placebo; it reports and directly compares efficacy and safety outcomes across the randomized groups.
Reports results from a double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized crossover trial, directly comparing NALL with placebo for neurologic efficacy and safety outcomes.

Reports primary clinical outcomes from a cluster-randomized crossover trial, directly comparing iodine povacrylex versus chlorhexidine antisepsis groups for surgical-site infection and other outcomes.
Reports primary outcome results from a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial, directly comparing infants assigned to early ibuprofen versus placebo.
Phase 3 double-blind trial randomly assigned 632 patients to acoramidis or placebo and directly compared efficacy and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
This phase 1–2 trial reports efficacy and safety outcomes for repotrectinib-treated cohorts, but no random allocation or comparison between randomized treatment groups is described.

Three participants received focused ultrasound with aducanumab, with treated brain regions compared against untreated contralateral regions. The abstract does not indicate random allocation, so this is not a randomized-group comparison.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled factorial trial, directly comparing clopidogrel plus aspirin with aspirin alone in the randomized groups.
This randomized, open-label human trial reports incident STI and safety outcomes and directly compares the doxycycline-PEP and standard-care groups created by randomization.

Reports outcome results comparing recombinant versus standard-dose influenza vaccines in a cluster-randomized study, with facilities assigned vaccine sequences and alternating formulations weekly. Randomized-group comparisons are presented for PCR-confirmed influenza and hospitalization outcomes.
Phase 3 double-blind trial that randomly assigned patients to elafibranor or placebo and reports direct between-group comparisons for efficacy and safety outcomes at week 52.

Reports primary results from a multicenter, double-blind randomized trial in which adults were assigned to botulinum toxin type A or placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of efficacy and adverse-event outcomes.
Observational genomic association study comparing survival in carriers versus noncarriers of actionable genotypes; no prospective randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled phase 2 trial, with direct comparisons of three randomized sibeprenlimab dose groups against placebo.

Reports results from a multicenter, double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial in 150 patients, with direct comparisons of primary, secondary, and safety outcomes across two thalidomide-dose groups and placebo.

This multicenter randomized controlled trial randomly assigned 261 patients to an everolimus-eluting resorbable scaffold or angioplasty and directly compared efficacy, safety, and adverse-event outcomes between the randomized groups.
Reports outcome results from a randomized controlled trial directly comparing simvastatin with no statin in critically ill patients with Covid-19.
Five-year follow-up results from a human randomized trial directly compare clinical and valve outcomes between the TAVR and surgery groups.

Phase 3 randomized human trial reporting direct comparisons between selpercatinib and physician-choice control groups for progression-free survival, treatment failure-free survival, response, and safety.
Phase 3 randomized human trial reporting efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons of both sotorasib-panitumumab dose groups against the randomized standard-care group.
Phase 3 human trial with 1:1:1 random allocation; it reports metastasis-free survival, safety, and quality-of-life results with direct comparisons between the randomized treatment groups.
Double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reporting direct comparisons of mortality, secondary endpoints, and serious adverse events between dexamethasone and placebo groups.
Phase 3b randomized active-controlled human trial reporting direct between-group comparisons of remission, relapse, response, MADRS scores, and safety for esketamine versus quetiapine.

This phase 1–2 dose-escalation and single-arm dose-expansion study reports outcomes for patients receiving mezigdomide plus dexamethasone, with no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison described.
This multicenter randomized trial assigned 1201 patients 1:1 to OCT-guided or angiography-guided PCI and directly compared 2-year MACE and procedural complications between the randomized groups.
Reports outcomes from 529 patients randomly assigned to semaglutide or placebo, with direct between-group comparisons of primary, secondary, and safety outcomes.
Reports primary efficacy and safety outcomes from a double-blind randomized trial, directly comparing patients assigned to edoxaban versus placebo.
This phase 1 study reports outcomes for a single divarasib treatment cohort across dose levels, with no indication of randomized allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.

This phase 1–2 dose-escalation study reports outcomes in five treated patients assigned to two dose cohorts, but the abstract does not indicate randomized allocation or a comparison between groups created by randomization.
Observational matched-cohort study comparing adults who had undergone thymectomy with demographically matched surgical controls; no prospective randomized allocation is reported.
Phase 3 human trial randomly assigned 7769 participants to pitavastatin or placebo and reports direct between-group comparisons of cardiovascular efficacy and safety outcomes.
Phase 3 human trial with participants randomly assigned 1:1 to solanezumab or placebo; cognitive, imaging, and safety outcomes are directly compared between the randomized groups.
This is explicitly a single-group phase 2 study in which all 16 patients received vemurafenib-cobimetinib; no randomized allocation or randomized between-group comparison is reported.

Reports results of a phase 2 randomized human trial directly comparing nivolumab plus chemotherapy versus chemotherapy alone, including pathological complete response, survival, surgery, and safety outcomes between randomized groups.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from two phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trials, with direct mirikizumab-versus-placebo comparisons for induction and maintenance outcomes.
This phase 2b double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial reports 24-week efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons between randomized pegozafermin dose groups and placebo.
Phase 2 randomized, double-blind human trial reporting efficacy and safety outcomes directly compared across randomized orforglipron dose groups and placebo.
Phase 3 human trial with patients randomly assigned to two bulevirtide dose groups or a control group; week-48 efficacy and safety outcomes are directly compared between the randomized groups.

Case series of four patients with DOCK11 mutations plus functional studies in patient-derived cells and animal models; no randomized human intervention or randomized-group outcome comparison is reported.

Prospective open-label trial that randomly assigned 795 participants to switch to dolutegravir or continue a ritonavir-boosted PI regimen and directly compared week-48 efficacy and safety outcomes between randomized groups.

Reports results of a prospective randomized trial comparing prehospital tranexamic acid with matched placebo, including functional survival, mortality, and adverse-event outcomes between the randomized groups.
Phase 3 double-blind randomized trial reporting direct dupilumab-versus-placebo comparisons for COPD exacerbations, lung function, quality of life, symptoms, and adverse events.
Reports clinical outcomes from a multicenter randomized, double-placebo comparison of intravenous tirofiban versus oral aspirin, including direct between-group efficacy and safety results at 90 days.

This multicenter randomized controlled noninferiority trial reports direct outcome comparisons between prophylactic platelet transfusion and no-transfusion groups, including catheter-related bleeding and adverse events.
Reports primary results from an international cluster-randomized trial of 80 hospitals, with direct outcome comparisons between the multicomponent intervention and usual-care groups.
This was explicitly a single-group prospective trial. Outcomes after endocrine-therapy interruption were compared with an external control cohort, not with a group created by randomized allocation.
This phase 1–2 human trial reports outcomes for a single GD2-CART01 treatment cohort with dose-level testing, but no randomized allocation or direct comparison between randomized groups is described.
Phase 3 human trial with 1:1 random assignment to RSVpreF vaccine or placebo; the report directly compares efficacy and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Phase 3 double-blind trial with adults randomly assigned 1:1 to sotatercept or placebo; it reports and directly compares primary, secondary, and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.

Prospective multicenter trial with patients randomly assigned to intravascular imaging-guided versus angiography-guided PCI; clinical and safety outcomes are directly compared between the randomized groups.
This phase 3 trial randomly assigned patients 2:1 to rucaparib or physician's-choice control and reports direct between-group comparisons of progression-free survival and adverse events.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a randomized controlled trial, directly comparing pegylated interferon lambda with placebo among outpatients with Covid-19.

This is an open-label, single-group phase 2 study in which all 103 patients received futibatinib; no randomized allocation or between-group comparison is reported.

Primary results of a pragmatic multicenter randomized noninferiority trial comparing aspirin with low-molecular-weight heparin after fracture, with direct between-group comparisons of mortality, thromboembolism, bleeding, and serious adverse events.

This is a retrospective cohort study of a random sample of hospital admissions. Random sampling was used, but participants were not randomly allocated to intervention groups, and no randomized-group comparison is reported.

This is a narrative review of menopause management after cancer. It summarizes evidence and treatment options but does not report results from a prospective randomized trial or compare randomized groups.
This Lancet Series paper proposes a conceptual empowerment model for menopause care. It does not describe randomized allocation or report outcomes comparing randomized groups.
Pooled analysis of population-representative observational studies estimating BMI-category prevalence and trends; no randomized intervention or comparison between randomized groups is reported.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a double-blind phase 2 trial in which 78 patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to sunitinib or placebo, with direct outcome comparisons between the randomized groups.

This is a narrative overview of Behçet's syndrome, including its pathogenesis, manifestations, diagnosis, and treatment. It reports no randomized trial results or comparison between randomized groups.

Reports results from a multicentre stepped-wedge cluster-randomized trial in which emergency departments were randomly assigned staggered switching dates. Outcomes, including symptomatic venous thromboembolism and bleeding, are directly compared between the randomized control and intervention phases.

Reports primary results from a prospective, double-blind randomized trial, with direct outcome comparisons between abatacept and placebo groups, including rheumatoid arthritis progression, survival, and safety.

Reports primary results from a multicentre parallel-group RCT in which pregnant women were randomly assigned 1:1 to revealed repeat PlGF-based testing or concealed repeat testing with usual care, with direct between-group comparisons of perinatal outcomes and serious adverse events.
Cross-sectional time-series analysis of population mortality data; no prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups.
Reports primary outcome results from a human cluster-randomized stepped-wedge trial, directly comparing intervention and control periods/groups; ICU implementation order was randomized.

Primary results of an individually randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial. The publication directly compares malaria, safety, and pregnancy outcomes between the two randomized treatment groups.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 2 human trial with two randomized stages, directly comparing BI 690517 dose groups with placebo, including analyses with and without empagliflozin.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 3 trial in which patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to standard therapy with or without atezolizumab, with direct between-group comparisons of progression-free survival, overall survival, and adverse events.

This is a narrative review of HIV epidemiology, prevention, treatment, and implementation advances. It does not report results from a prospective randomized trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from two phase 3 randomized, double-blind trials, with direct comparisons among randomized ligelizumab, omalizumab, and placebo groups.

This is a systematic review and meta-analysis of 52 randomized trials, not a report of results from a single prospective randomized clinical trial. The randomized comparisons are pooled across included studies.
Qualitative interview study using purposive sampling; no randomized treatment allocation or comparison between randomized groups was reported.
This is a descriptive report of a COVID-19 public health modelling collaboration. It does not describe randomized allocation or report outcomes comparing randomized groups.

This is a retrospective case-series analysis of routine surveillance data on pediatric invasive group A streptococcal infections. There was no randomized intervention allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

trial_name_or_acronym: Growing Up in Ireland Cohort 98' Study
brief_rationale: Explicitly described as a longitudinal observational cohort study. Parental smoking was measured as an exposure rather than randomly assigned, and outcomes were analyzed using adjusted exposure-group associations; no randomized-group comparison is reported.

This multisite clinical simulation study evaluated 14 participants across educational scenarios, with performance scores and feedback reported. No random allocation to intervention groups or comparison between randomized groups is described.
This publication is a rapid review synthesizing nine studies, not a report of results from a prospective randomized clinical trial with a direct randomized-group comparison.
This is a rapid realist review of 26 articles, not a report of a prospective randomized clinical trial or a direct comparison between randomized groups.

This is a longitudinal observational qualitative study using purposively sampled focus groups. It reports perceptions of growth screening but involves no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
This is a cross-sectional online survey using observational logistic-regression analyses. There was no randomized intervention allocation or comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.
This is a modelling study using publicly available NHS activity data to estimate elective procedure backlogs. It involves no prospective randomized allocation and no comparison of randomized groups.

Reports primary outcome results from a prospective cluster-randomized trial in which 18 schools were randomly assigned to walking intervention or usual-activity control, with post-intervention physical activity directly compared between groups.
Qualitative study using purposive and snowball sampling with semi-structured interviews; no randomized intervention allocation or comparison between randomized groups was reported.

This is a cross-sectional post-workshop questionnaire study with before-versus-after self-reported measures. Participants were not randomly allocated to comparator groups, and no randomized-group comparison is reported.

This is an observational interrupted time-series analysis comparing purchasing before versus during COVID-19 restrictions. The intervention was not randomly allocated, so no randomized-group comparison is reported.
Two experimental case studies evaluated AI/video-glasses methods and algorithm accuracy; there was no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups.

Qualitative service-improvement study using four focus groups; there was no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Qualitative preparatory engagement study involving four discussion events; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups was reported.

Qualitative implementation evaluation conducted alongside the randomized Gateway Study. It reports interview themes about implementation and recruitment, not outcomes compared between the randomized groups.

Mixed-methods service-improvement audit with a pre-intervention versus intervention-period comparison. The intervention was implemented for all scheduled appointments without random allocation, so no randomized-group comparison is reported.

This is a scoping review that identifies and narratively synthesizes prior studies; it does not report results from a prospective randomized trial or compare randomized groups.

trial_name_or_acronym: Women's Wellness with Type 2 Diabetes Programme (WWDP)
brief_rationale: This mixed-methods intervention-refinement study analyzes prior feasibility data and stakeholder consultations. It does not establish random allocation or report a direct comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.
Retrospective cross-sectional analysis of routinely collected general-practice data; no prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups was reported.
This is a systematic review with descriptive synthesis of 59 studies, including randomized trials, rather than a report of results from a single randomized clinical trial comparing allocated groups.

Reports primary results of a pragmatic cluster-randomised trial in which GP practices were randomly allocated to an implementation letter or usual care, with prescription uptake directly compared between groups.

This is explicitly a cross-sectional observational study using clustered sampling. It assesses associations between friendship quality and wellbeing without randomized intervention allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.

This is a secondary mixed-methods analysis of a cross-sectional household survey and purposively sampled qualitative interviews. Random selection was used for survey sampling, not randomized intervention allocation, and no randomized-group comparison is reported.

Process evaluation alongside a randomized trial, based on interviews and goal records from intervention recipients and intervention workers. It reports qualitative and descriptive findings but does not compare outcomes between the randomized intervention and usual-care groups.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled crossover trial, directly comparing ubrogepant with placebo across randomized treatment sequences.

Reports primary results from a prospective randomized controlled trial, with patients randomly assigned 1:1 to high-dose primaquine or standard care and outcomes directly compared between randomized groups.

This is a global climate-and-health monitoring report using indicators, observational analyses, and projections. It does not describe randomized allocation or report a comparison between randomized intervention groups.
This is a general narrative review of multiple sclerosis pathophysiology, diagnosis, and treatment. It does not report a randomized trial or a comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.

Final 2-year results of a double-blind phase 3 trial using permuted-block randomization to sparsentan or irbesartan; kidney efficacy and safety outcomes are directly compared between the randomized groups.

This is a narrative review of work as a social determinant of health. It does not report a randomized clinical trial or a comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.

Reports primary clinical and cost-effectiveness results from a prospective randomized controlled trial, with 642 adults randomly assigned 1:1 and outcomes directly compared between sleep restriction therapy and sleep hygiene groups.

Prospective multicohort study developing and validating the LiverRisk prognostic score. Participants were classified into risk groups based on score cutoffs, not randomly allocated to interventions, so no randomized-group comparison is reported.

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a double-blind phase 3 trial with central 1:1 random allocation to everolimus or placebo and direct between-group comparisons of recurrence-free survival and adverse events.

Phase 3 human trial with participants randomly assigned to two atogepant regimens or placebo; it reports efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons of each randomized atogepant group versus placebo.

Phase 3 randomized, double-blind withdrawal trial reporting efficacy and safety outcomes directly compared between patients randomized to continue baricitinib or receive placebo.

Primary results of a prospective stepped-wedge cluster randomized trial. Hospitals were randomly assigned to implementation sequences, and outcomes were directly compared between care-bundle and usual-care groups, including 6-month functional outcome and serious adverse events.

Explicitly described as an observational cohort study using registry data. It evaluates associations between blood pressure measures and mortality without randomized treatment allocation or a comparison between randomized groups.
This is a clinical Seminar reviewing haemochromatosis pathophysiology, diagnosis, treatment, and outcomes; it does not report a randomized trial or a comparison between randomized groups.

Phase 3 human trial with block randomization to trastuzumab deruxtecan or physician's choice; it reports direct between-group comparisons of progression-free survival and safety outcomes.
Prospective observational birth cohort comparing naturally occurring RSV infection status; infants were not randomly allocated to infection groups or interventions.

Primary results of a phase 3 randomized controlled trial comparing endovascular treatment with no endovascular treatment. The abstract reports direct between-group comparisons for 90-day modified Rankin Scale, mortality, and symptomatic intracranial haemorrhage.

The publication explicitly reports an observational longitudinal analysis of inspection data. It does not describe randomized allocation or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

Collaborative secondary analysis of participants from three randomized trials, but outcomes are compared across baseline CRP and LDL cholesterol quartiles rather than between randomized treatment groups; treatment assignment is only an adjustment variable.

This Seminar is a narrative review of systemic sclerosis diagnosis, pathogenesis, and management; it does not report outcomes comparing randomized trial groups.

Primary results of a multicentre, double-blind, phase 3 randomized trial. Patients were assigned 1:1 to rezafungin or caspofungin, and efficacy and safety outcomes were directly compared between the randomized groups.

Reports primary outcome results from a double-blind trial in which 5352 patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to active H pylori eradication or placebo, with peptic ulcer bleeding outcomes directly compared between randomized groups.
Global climate-and-health indicator report based on observational and aggregate analyses; it does not describe randomized allocation or report a comparison between randomized groups.
This Seminar reviews the causes, diagnosis, and treatment of haemolytic uraemic syndrome; it does not report a randomized clinical trial or a comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.

trial_name_or_acronym: Treatment in Morning versus Evening (TIME) study

Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 3 trial with genuine 1:1 random allocation to atezolizumab or placebo and direct between-group comparisons of disease-free survival and adverse events.

Population-based observational cohort study using linked health records and matched controls. There was no randomized treatment allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

This Seminar is a narrative clinical review of interstitial lung diseases, covering epidemiology, diagnosis, management, guidelines, and future directions. It does not report results from a randomized trial or compare randomized groups.
Prospective observational cohort study comparing participants with COVID-19 against matched uninfected controls; there was no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison.
Primary results from a prospective 2×2 factorial cluster-randomized trial in infants. Food allergy outcomes at 36 months are directly compared across the randomized intervention groups.

Observational population-level analysis using death registration and census-derived population data with small-area estimation models; no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups.

Prespecified interim results from a phase 3 human trial with 184 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to liso-cel or standard of care; efficacy and safety outcomes are directly compared between the randomized groups.

Phase 3 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled maintenance trial reporting week 52 efficacy and safety outcomes with direct comparisons of the randomized risankizumab 180 mg, risankizumab 360 mg, and placebo-withdrawal groups.

This is a systematic disease-burden analysis synthesizing data from hundreds of studies using statistical models. It does not report prospective randomized allocation or a comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.

This Series paper presents a political science framework and policy discussion on universal health coverage; it does not describe a randomized clinical trial or report a randomized-group outcome comparison.
Reports primary outcome results from a human randomized clinical trial directly comparing Mediterranean and low-fat diet groups, including group-specific cardiovascular event rates and hazard ratios.

Reports primary 18-month outcomes from an open cluster-randomized human trial in which 326 villages were randomly assigned to a village doctor-led intervention or enhanced usual care, with direct between-group comparisons of blood pressure control and changes.
This Series paper summarizes evidence and clinical management recommendations for cancer survivors; it does not report results from a randomized trial or compare randomized groups.

Prospective observational app-based study comparing matched participants infected during periods of omicron versus delta dominance; no randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison was reported.
Phase 3 randomized, double-blind trial reporting direct comparisons between cabotegravir and TDF-FTC groups for incident HIV infection and adverse events.

Health Policy evidence-synthesis and economic modelling paper estimating intervention packages, costs, and mortality effects across countries; it does not report a prospective randomized trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

Primary results of a multicentre randomized controlled trial in which women were randomly assigned to assistance by one versus two midwives, with severe perineal trauma directly compared between groups.

This is a subnational observational disease-burden analysis using multiple data sources and statistical models. It reports regional and temporal estimates but no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

This is a narrative overview of pharmacologic osteoporosis management that summarizes evidence across drug classes. It does not report results from a specific randomized trial or a direct comparison between randomized groups.
Reports primary safety and efficacy results from a multicentre, double-blind phase 2 trial with random 1:1 allocation to CAP-1002 or placebo and direct between-group outcome comparisons at 12 months.

This is a narrative clinical review of measles covering diagnosis, complications, management, and prevention; it does not report a randomized trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

Observational national data-linkage study comparing outcomes among individuals with SGTF, non-SGTF, or delta infections. There was no prospective randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison.

Reports phase 3 efficacy and safety results from a double-blind trial in which adults were randomized 1:1 to Ad5-nCoV vaccine or placebo, with direct outcome comparisons between the randomized groups.

Narrative overview of COVID-19 diagnostic methods and their public-health roles; it reports no prospective randomized trial or randomized-group outcome comparison.
This is a systematic review and network meta-analysis synthesizing results from 143 randomized controlled trials, not a report of results from a single prospective randomized trial.

This Series paper provides a broad narrative overview of adolescent growth, nutrition, and intervention strategies; it does not report results from a randomized clinical trial or compare randomized groups.

Reports results from a prospective randomized controlled trial in 420 cardiac surgery patients, with direct comparisons between posterior left pericardiotomy and no-intervention groups for postoperative atrial fibrillation and safety outcomes.

This is a general clinical review of borderline personality disorder, its course, outcomes, and management. It does not report a randomized trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

trial_name_or_acronym: Study of Mirtazapine for Agitated Behaviours in Dementia (SYMBAD)

Observational modeling study comparing mortality data sources and estimating under-reporting; no prospective randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
Reports primary results from a double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial in children, directly comparing symptom duration and safety between amoxicillin and placebo groups.
This is a narrative review of interstitial lung disease histopathology and progressive fibrosis; it does not report a randomized clinical trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

This Series paper provides a global overview and summarizes findings from meta-analyses; it does not report results from a prospective randomized trial or directly compare randomized groups.

This is a global and regional modelling study using administrative, immunisation-system, and mobility data. It does not prospectively randomize human participants or report a comparison between randomized intervention groups.

This is a qualitative interview and focus-group study evaluating experiences with home-based care. It reports no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

Prospective multicentre randomized controlled trial reporting primary and safety outcomes with direct comparisons between the delayed and more-delayed RRT initiation groups.
Policy/perspective article on global R&D preparedness and financing; it does not report results from a randomized clinical trial or compare randomized groups.

Phase 3 human trial with genuine randomized allocation, including an initial bimekizumab-versus-placebo comparison and randomized withdrawal/maintenance groups. The report presents direct between-group efficacy and safety results.
Phase 1 randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial reporting interim safety and immunogenicity outcomes with direct comparisons among randomized vaccine formulations and placebo.
This is a narrative overview of therapies targeting the IL-23/IL-17 pathway in psoriasis. It does not report outcomes from a randomized trial or directly compare randomized groups.
This is a narrative discussion of political and security issues affecting humanitarian health responses. It reports no prospective randomized trial, outcomes, or randomized-group comparison.

This is explicitly a prospective cohort study of consecutive surgical patients. It reports observational comparisons by country income level, with no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Reports primary outcome and safety results from a prospective computer-randomized crossover trial, directly comparing the two hybrid closed-loop systems during the randomized treatment periods.

trial_name_or_acronym: Lopinavir Trial for Suppression of SARS-CoV-2 in China
brief_rationale: This is an ambidirectional observational cohort study of discharged COVID-19 patients. It compares outcomes by disease-severity categories rather than randomized treatment groups; the subset drawn from a named trial is used only for antibody follow-up without a randomized arm-level comparison.
Reports primary 6-month clinical and safety outcomes from a prospective randomized controlled trial, directly comparing tranexamic acid with care as usual.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a prospective randomized, double-blind trial, directly comparing rimegepant with placebo.
This Seminar is a broad narrative overview of the assessment and management of male infertility; it does not report a randomized clinical trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

This is a narrative overview of primary biliary cholangitis, including disease features and available treatments. It does not report results from a randomized trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

Reports 48-week efficacy and safety results from a phase 3b trial with 1045 adults randomly assigned 1:1 to every-8-week versus every-4-week dosing, with direct comparisons between the randomized groups.

Explicitly described as an observational evaluation of large-scale SMC implementation, using coverage surveys, case-control studies, and routine surveillance data. No prospective random allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a phase 3 randomized, double-blind trial, directly comparing pembrolizumab plus chemotherapy with placebo plus chemotherapy in the randomized groups.

This is a Health Policy paper comparing health-system approaches and synthesizing policy recommendations; it does not report a prospective randomized clinical trial or a randomized-group outcome comparison.
Reports primary clinical and safety outcomes from a multicentre, double-blind randomized trial, directly comparing participants assigned to ferric carboxymaltose versus placebo.
Phase 3 human trial with genuine 1:1 random allocation that reports direct between-group comparisons for progression-free survival, adverse events, neuropathy, and mortality.

Prospective observational cohort analysis relating measured LDL cholesterol to cardiovascular outcomes. Participants were not randomly allocated to interventions, and no randomized-group comparison is reported; the statin NNT was estimated rather than observed in a trial.
This is a systematic review and individual-patient-data meta-analysis combining results from four randomized trials, not a report of results from a single randomized clinical trial.
Pooled analysis of population-based observational studies using Bayesian modeling of height and BMI trends; no prospective randomized allocation or randomized-group comparison is reported.
This is a narrative overview of stroke systems of care. It does not describe randomized allocation or report outcomes comparing randomized groups.
Prespecified 3-year follow-up of a randomized trial that reports and directly compares clinical outcomes between the DCB and DES groups.

trial_name_or_acronym: Global Burden of Diseases, Injuries, and Risk Factors Study (GBD) 2019
brief_rationale: This is a systematic population-level disease-burden analysis using multiple observational data sources and statistical models. It does not describe randomized allocation or compare outcomes between randomized groups.
This is a narrative clinical review of functional dyspepsia, its pathophysiology, diagnosis, and treatment. It does not report results from a randomized trial or compare randomized groups.
Reports primary clinical outcomes from a prospective randomized trial, directly comparing lopinavir-ritonavir plus usual care with usual care alone among hospitalized patients with COVID-19.

Primary results of a multicentre, three-arm randomized clinical trial in adults. It reports 12-month outcomes, adverse events, and cost-effectiveness with direct comparisons among the randomized treatment groups.
This is a prospectively planned systematic review and aggregate-data meta-analysis of three randomized controlled trials, not a report of results from a single randomized clinical trial.

Phase 3 human trial with 1396 patients randomly assigned to adjuvant radiotherapy or observation with salvage radiotherapy; it reports direct between-group comparisons of efficacy, safety, and patient-reported outcomes.
International observational cohort study using ELSO Registry data. It reports outcomes among patients who received ECMO but includes no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

Double-blind phase 3 trial with 333 patients randomly assigned 1:1 to atezolizumab plus chemotherapy or placebo plus chemotherapy; it directly compares pathological complete response and safety outcomes between the randomized groups.
Large-scale retrospective analysis of survey data using temporal modeling and regression; no prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized intervention groups is reported.

Reports primary results from a prospective double-blind randomized trial comparing intravenous iron with placebo, including direct between-group comparisons of transfusion, mortality, and safety outcomes.
The publication explicitly describes two open, non-randomised phase 1/2 studies. It reports safety and immunogenicity results, but participants were not randomly allocated to comparator groups.

Reports primary results from a prospective double-blind randomized placebo-controlled trial, with direct outcome comparisons between the mifepristone-plus-misoprostol and placebo-plus-misoprostol groups.

This is explicitly a prospective observational cohort with retrospective patient identification. Outcomes were compared by naturally occurring SARS-CoV-2 variant infection, not by randomized allocation.
This is a narrative review summarizing atopic dermatitis pathophysiology and management advances; it does not report a randomized trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.
Nationwide observational seroepidemiological survey using random population sampling, not randomized allocation to intervention groups; no randomized-group comparison is reported.

Reports primary results from a prospective randomized, blinded, parallel-group trial comparing ThuVARP with TURP. Outcomes, including Qmax, IPSS, hospital stay, and complications, are directly compared between the randomized groups.
This is a narrative overview of current and emerging treatments and future research directions for opioid withdrawal; it does not report results or a comparison between randomized groups.
Primary results of a prospective randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled human trial, with mortality and thromboembolic outcomes directly compared between tranexamic acid and placebo groups.
Narrative review of meningococcal sexual transmission, outbreaks, and bacterial evolution; it reports no prospective randomized trial or randomized-group outcome comparison.
This is a narrative review of primary health-care quality challenges and policy recommendations in China; it does not report a randomized clinical trial or any randomized-group outcome comparison.
Descriptive perspective on China's COVID-19 containment strategies; it reports no prospective randomized trial, outcomes by randomized group, or randomized between-group comparison.
This phase 1 dose-escalation trial explicitly states that it was non-randomised; participants were sequentially enrolled into three dose groups, so no randomized-group comparison is reported.

This is explicitly a prospective cohort study comparing women and men in the PURE population. There was no randomized allocation to intervention groups and therefore no randomized-group outcome comparison.

This is explicitly a prospective observational cohort study of critically ill adults with COVID-19. It reports clinical outcomes and risk-factor associations but no randomized treatment allocation or comparison between randomized groups.

This is a broad narrative discussion/review of artificial intelligence applications in global health. It does not describe randomized allocation or report a comparison of outcomes between randomized groups.
Observational population-level analysis of mortality trends using surveys and other data sources; no randomized intervention allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.

This is a hypothesis/commentary article on SARS-CoV-2 pathogenesis based on clinical observations, autopsy evidence, and basic science research. It reports no randomized clinical trial or randomized-group outcome comparison.
Pragmatic cluster-randomized trial reporting parasite prevalence outcomes directly compared between clusters assigned to PBO-containing versus conventional LLINs.
Descriptive article documenting the concept, characteristics, and functions of Fangcang shelter hospitals; it reports no randomized allocation or between-group outcome comparison.

This is a policy/commentary article proposing principles for post-marketing evidence generation. It does not report results from a randomized human trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.

Systematic review and individual-participant meta-analysis of prospective and retrospective cohort studies. Preventive therapy effectiveness was estimated observationally using propensity-score matching, not by comparing randomized treatment groups.

This is a broad narrative review of eating disorders, their diagnosis, pathophysiology, treatment, and research needs. It does not report a randomized trial or compare outcomes between randomized groups.
Reports primary efficacy and safety results from a multicentre randomized clinical trial, with direct outcome comparisons between the randomly assigned TACT and ACT treatment groups.
Reports primary results from a three-arm human trial with centralized computer randomization. Progression-free survival and safety outcomes are directly compared across the randomized treatment arms.
Phase 2 randomized controlled trial reporting primary endpoint results with a direct comparison between the ART-only and ART plus kick-and-kill randomized groups.

Reports primary results of an international randomized controlled trial using central computerized 1:1 allocation, with direct comparisons of 90-day mortality and major complications between accelerated-surgery and standard-care groups.

Reports primary clinical and economic results from a multicentre RCT in which 540 patients were randomly assigned 1:1 to plaster cast or functional brace, with direct between-group comparisons of functional outcome, re-upture, and costs.

Therapeutic review summarizing the biological rationale and clinical efficacy of type 2-targeted asthma treatments; it does not report results from a randomized trial or a randomized-group comparison.
Observational report of a COVID-19 family cluster with epidemiological, clinical, and virological findings; there was no randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
Reports primary clinical and economic results from a multicentre participant-masked randomized trial, with direct outcome comparisons between the FLACS and PCS groups.
Observational global burden modelling analysis based on death and hospital records; no prospective randomized allocation or comparison between randomized groups is reported.

trial_name_or_acronym: International Breast Cancer Intervention Study II (IBIS-II)
brief_rationale: Long-term follow-up of a randomized, double-blind trial reporting direct outcome comparisons between the anastrozole and placebo groups, including breast cancer incidence, mortality, and adverse events.

Prespecified interim overall-survival follow-up of a phase 3 trial with genuine 1:1 permuted-block randomization. It directly compares overall survival, progression-free survival, and safety between the randomized D-VMP and VMP groups.

This is a prospective population-based cohort study comparing disease incidence, hospital admissions, and mortality across country income levels. It reports no randomized intervention allocation or comparison between randomized groups.
